edges.reason: msg.sender determines whose allowance is debited and can trigger the newun auto-assignment branch in transferFrom.
transfer() passes _msgSender() as the debit source.
Constructor credits the entire supply to _msgSender().
unlock() requires msg.sender to equal _previousOwner before restoring ownership.
Constructor writes the initial supply into _balances.
lock() writes _lockTime.
lock() stores the outgoing owner in _previousOwner.
lock() zeroes _owner.
lock() uses block.timestamp to compute the lock deadline, making the lock period miner-influenced.
The time parameter feeds the timestamp arithmetic inside lock().
now is an operand of the now + time computation.
time is an operand of the now + time computation.
Result of now + time is stored in _lockTime.
lock() executes the timestamp arithmetic statement.
unlock() compares the current block timestamp with _lockTime.
_lockTime is the threshold checked in the unlock guard.
_previousOwner is read and compared against msg.sender in unlock().
unlock() reads _previousOwner to restore it as owner.
The timestamp/owner guard gates the ownership restoration path of unlock().
unlock() branches on the _lockTime timestamp condition.
unlock() reassigns ownership in _owner.
The onlyOwner guard compares _owner against the caller.
onlyOwner gate on transferOwnership().
onlyOwner gate on mint().
onlyOwner gate on transfernewun().
pause() is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
unpause() is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferOwnership() checks _owner via onlyOwner.
renounceOwnership() checks _owner via onlyOwner.
mint() is privileged to the owner, enabling unlimited supply inflation.
transferOwnership() overwrites _owner.
renounceOwnership() clears _owner.
pause() flips the paused flag.
unpause() flips the paused flag.
whenNotPaused modifier reads paused before executing pause().
whenPaused modifier reads paused before executing unpause().
_transfer consults the paused flag (with owner exemptions) to allow or block movement.
transfernewun() writes the newun whitelist address.
The _newun parameter is stored as the privileged recipient.
transferFrom() branches on newun to decide whether the recipient is allowed.
transferFrom() takes the branch that silently assigns newun to recipient.
The auto-assignment branch mutates the newun state variable.
transferFrom() writes newun = recipient when newun is still zero.
transferFrom() delegates the balance movement to _transfer.
transferFrom() reduces allowance through _approve.
transferFrom() reads _allowances to subtract the spent amount.
transfer() delegates to _transfer.
approve() delegates to _approve.
increaseAllowance() writes the new allowance via _approve.
decreaseAllowance() writes the new allowance via _approve.
increaseAllowance() reads the current allowance before adding.
decreaseAllowance() reads the current allowance before subtracting.
increaseAllowance() adds addedValue to the stored allowance.
decreaseAllowance() subtracts subtractedValue from the stored allowance.
_transfer reads balances prior to mutation.
_transfer uses the sender/recipient balances as input.
_transfer performs the SafeMath sub/add pair on balances.
The balance arithmetic writes the updated _balances entries.
_approve writes the nested allowance mapping.
mint() increases the total supply without any cap.
mint() credits arbitrary balances.
mint() executes SafeMath.add on supply and balance.
The mint arithmetic updates _totalSupply.
The mint arithmetic updates _balances.
newOwner parameter becomes the new privileged address.
recipient parameter is credited inside _transfer.
amount parameter drives the balance sub/add arithmetic.
sender parameter is the debited account inside _transfer.
spender parameter is the allowance target in _approve.
addedValue is added to the allowance.
subtractedValue is subtracted from the allowance.
_to receives minted balances from the owner-only mint.
_amount is added to both supply and balance in mint.
The cached msgSender local is used to credit the constructor allocation.

normalization_plan.reason: The time parameter only exists to compute the lock timestamp inside lock().
newOwner is the sole input of transferOwnership() and is meaningless outside it.
recipient is consumed by the internal balance credit routine.
amount is consumed by the internal balance arithmetic routine.
sender is consumed by the internal balance debit routine.
spender is only used to index the allowance mapping in _approve().
addedValue is a temporary input to the allowance increment function.
subtractedValue is a temporary input to the allowance decrement function.
_newun is a temporary input whose only role is to set the newun state variable.
_to is a temporary mint target and carries no independent semantics.
_amount is a temporary mint quantity used only in the supply arithmetic.
The msgSender local is a short-lived cache of _msgSender() used only during construction.
